MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"Paranoia mode enables maximum scrutiny. All edge cases trigger warnings. Best for high-security needs." to "パラノイアモードは最大限の精査を有効にします。すべてのエッジケースが警告をトリガーします。高セキュリティニーズに最適です。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"Real-time audit logs of all QR code captures, including verdicts from the local heuristic engine." to "ローカルヒューリスティックエンジンの判定を含む、すべてのQRコード捕捉のリアルタイム監査ログ。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"Score based on heuristic analysis of domain age, entropy, and keyword matching." to "スコアはドメイン年齢、エントロピー、キーワード一致のヒューリスティック分析に基づきます。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The ML model classified this URL as benign with high certainty. The structure matches known legitimate authentication patterns." to "ML モデルはこの URL を高い確信で良性と分類しました。構造は既知の正当な認証パターンと一致します。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The URL appears to impersonate a well-known brand, which is a common phishing tactic." to "URLは有名ブランドを偽装しているようです。これは一般的なフィッシング手法です。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The URL has an unusual number of subdomains, which can be used to mislead users." to "URLには異常な数のサブドメインがあり、ユーザーを誤解させるために使用される可能性があります。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The URL is unusually long, which can be used to hide the actual destination." to "URLが異常に長く、実際の宛先を隠すために使用される可能性があります。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, which is unusual for legitimate sites." to "URLはドメイン名ではなくIPアドレスを使用しており、正規のサイトでは珍しいです。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The domain micros0ft-support.com uses a zero '0' instead of the letter 'o'." to "ドメイン micros0ft-support.com は文字 'o' の代わりに数字の '0' を使用しています。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The domain uses a top-level domain commonly associated with malicious sites." to "ドメインは悪意のあるサイトに関連付けられることが多いTLDを使用しています。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "脅威シグネチャデータベース全体がミリ秒単位の検索のためにデバイスにダウンロードされます。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"The scanned QR code redirects to a known phishing vector designed to harvest credentials." to "スキャンされたQRコードは、認証情報を収集するために設計された既知のフィッシングベクターにリダイレクトします。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "このURLは安全に訪問できるようです。分析ではフィッシング指標は検出されませんでした。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"This URL appears to be safe with a risk score of %d. No significant phishing indicators were detected." to "このURLはリスクスコア%dで安全に見えます。重大なフィッシング指標は検出されませんでした。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"This URL has some suspicious characteristics with a risk score of %d. Several potential phishing indicators were found." to "このURLはリスクスコア%dで疑わしい特徴があります。複数の潜在的なフィッシング指標が見つかりました。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"This URL is likely malicious with a high risk score of %d. Multiple strong phishing indicators were detected." to "このURLは高リスクスコア%dで悪意がある可能性が高いです。複数の強力なフィッシング指標が検出されました。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"This will permanently delete all scan records. This action cannot be undone." to "すべてのスキャン記録が完全に削除されます。この操作は元に戻せません。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"This will reset all settings to their default values. Your scan history will not be affected." to "すべての設定がデフォルト値にリセットされます。スキャン履歴は影響を受けません。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "QRコードを直接スキャンするには、デバイスのカメラアクセスを有効にするか、下の手動入力オプションを使用してください。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "有効なSSL証明書があります。注意: 有効なSSLはサイトの正当性を保証しません。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"Verified ownership by Microsoft Corporation via EV Certificate." to "EV 証明書により Microsoft Corporation の所有が確認されています。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "スキャンの送信テレメトリを厳密に無効にしています。スキャン結果と画像ハッシュはローカルに保持されます。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsJa.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to " .com は標準ですが、\"support\" を含むハイフン構造はフィッシングでよく見られます。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "균형 모드는 표준 휴리스틱을 사용합니다. 알려진 악성 패턴과 의심스러운 URL 단축기를 플래그합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "코드 실행은 임시 컨테이너에서 발생합니다. 악성 페이로드는 OS 커널에 절대 접근하지 않습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "완전한 분석이 로컬에서 수행됩니다. 카메라 피드와 스캔된 데이터는 절대 외부 서버에 닿지 않아 완전한 프라이버시를 보장합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Corporate IT sent a reset notice using the official Google auth domain." to "기업 IT가 공식 Google 인증 도메인을 사용하여 재설정 알림을 보냈습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "단순히 \"차단\"만 받지 마세요. URL 매개변수, 리디렉션 및 자바스크립트 페이로드에 대한 상세한 휴리스틱 분석을 제공합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "Starbeans Coffee의 테이블에서 발견했습니다. 로그인하면 무료 커피 쿠폰을 제공했습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "단축키: Cmd/Ctrl+V URL 붙여넣기, Cmd/Ctrl+, 설정, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 탐색, Enter 분석, Escape 뒤로"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Let's Encrypt R3. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Let's Encrypt R3. 참고: 유효한 SSL이 사이트의 합법성을 보장하지는 않습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "낮음 모드는 오탐지를 줄입니다. 확인된 악성 패턴만 플래그합니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 환경에 가장 적합합니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "오프라인 휴리스틱, 데이터 보존 정책 및 도메인 허용 목록을 관리합니다. 모든 변경사항이 즉시 적용됩니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Mehr Guard analyses potential threats directly on your hardware. Experience zero-latency phishing detection without compromising data privacy." to "Mehr Guard는 하드웨어에서 직접 잠재적 위협을 분석합니다. 데이터 프라이버시를 손상시키지 않고 지연 없는 피싱 탐지를 경험하세요."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. No image data, scanned URLs, or telemetry are sent to the cloud for analysis." to "Mehr Guard는 로컬 하드웨어에서 완전히 작동합니다. 이미지 데이터, 스캔한 URL 또는 원격 측정이 클라우드로 전송되지 않습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. We prioritize explainable security with zero cloud telemetry for image analysis." to "Mehr Guard는 모든 스캔을 안전하고 격리된 로컬 샌드박스 내에서 처리합니다. 이미지 분석을 위해 클라우드 텔레메트리 없이 설명 가능한 보안을 우선시합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Mixed script characters detected in domain name intended to spoof legitimate brands." to "합법적인 브랜드를 사칭하기 위한 도메인 이름에서 혼합 스크립트 문자가 감지되었습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Multiple phishing indicators detected. See threat score for details." to "여러 피싱 지표가 감지되었습니다. 자세한 내용은 위협 점수를 참조하세요."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"No mixed-script characters or IDN spoofing detected in domain string." to "도메인 문자열에서 혼합 스크립트 문자 또는 IDN 스푸핑이 감지되지 않았습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Offline mode enabled. Disable Strict Offline Mode to open URLs." to "오프라인 모드가 활성화되었습니다. URL을 열려면 엄격한 오프라인 모드를 비활성화하세요."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Optimised for desktop environments. Scans are processed in under 5ms using native Kotlin Multiplatform binaries." to "데스크톱 환경에 최적화되었습니다. 스캔은 네이티브 Kotlin Multiplatform 바이너리를 사용하여 5ms 미만에 처리됩니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Paranoia mode enables maximum scrutiny. All edge cases trigger warnings. Best for high-security needs." to "편집증 모드는 최대 조사를 활성화합니다. 모든 엣지 케이스가 경고를 트리거합니다. 높은 보안 요구에 가장 적합합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Real-time audit logs of all QR code captures, including verdicts from the local heuristic engine." to "로컬 휴리스틱 엔진의 판정을 포함한 모든 QR 코드 캡처의 실시간 감사 로그."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Score based on heuristic analysis of domain age, entropy, and keyword matching." to "도메인 나이, 엔트로피 및 키워드 매칭의 휴리스틱 분석을 기반으로 한 점수."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The ML model classified this URL as benign with high certainty. The structure matches known legitimate authentication patterns." to "ML 모델이 이 URL을 높은 확신도로 양성으로 분류했습니다. 구조가 알려진 정상적인 인증 패턴과 일치합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The URL appears to impersonate a well-known brand, which is a common phishing tactic." to "URL이 유명 브랜드를 사칭하는 것으로 보입니다. 이는 일반적인 피싱 수법입니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The URL has an unusual number of subdomains, which can be used to mislead users." to "URL에 비정상적인 수의 하위 도메인이 있으며, 이는 사용자를 오도하는 데 사용될 수 있습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The URL is unusually long, which can be used to hide the actual destination." to "URL이 비정상적으로 길어 실제 목적지를 숨기는 데 사용될 수 있습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, which is unusual for legitimate sites." to "URL이 도메인 이름 대신 IP 주소를 사용하며, 이는 합법적인 사이트에서는 드문 경우입니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The domain micros0ft-support.com uses a zero '0' instead of the letter 'o'." to "도메인 micros0ft-support.com은 문자 'o' 대신 숫자 '0'을 사용합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "전체 위협 서명 데이터베이스가 밀리초 조회를 위해 장치에 다운로드됩니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"The scanned QR code redirects to a known phishing vector designed to harvest credentials." to "스캔한 QR 코드가 자격 증명을 수집하도록 설계된 알려진 피싱 벡터로 리디렉션됩니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "이 URL은 방문하기에 안전해 보입니다. 분석에서 피싱 지표가 감지되지 않았습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"This URL appears to be safe with a risk score of %d. No significant phishing indicators were detected." to "이 URL은 위험 점수 %d로 안전해 보입니다. 중요한 피싱 지표가 감지되지 않았습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"This URL has some suspicious characteristics with a risk score of %d. Several potential phishing indicators were found." to "이 URL은 위험 점수 %d로 의심스러운 특성이 있습니다. 여러 잠재적 피싱 지표가 발견되었습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"This URL is likely malicious with a high risk score of %d. Multiple strong phishing indicators were detected." to "이 URL은 높은 위험 점수 %d로 악성일 가능성이 높습니다. 여러 강력한 피싱 지표가 감지되었습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"This will permanently delete all scan records. This action cannot be undone." to "모든 스캔 기록이 영구적으로 삭제됩니다. 이 작업은 취소할 수 없습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"This will reset all settings to their default values. Your scan history will not be affected." to "모든 설정이 기본값으로 재설정됩니다. 스캔 기록은 영향을 받지 않습니다."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "QR 코드를 직접 스캔하려면 장치에서 카메라 액세스를 활성화하거나 아래의 수동 입력 옵션을 사용하세요."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "유효한 SSL 인증서가 있습니다. 참고: 유효한 SSL이 사이트 합법성을 보장하지 않습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"Verified ownership by Microsoft Corporation via EV Certificate." to "Microsoft Corporation이 EV 인증서를 통해 소유권을 확인했습니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "스캔에 대한 발신 텔레메트리를 엄격히 비활성화합니다. 스캔 결과와 이미지 해시는 로컬에 유지됩니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsKo.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to ".com은 표준이지만, \"support\"가 포함된 하이픈 구조는 피싱에서 흔합니다."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"A shortened link shared in a group chat without context." to "Um link encurtado compartilhado em um chat de grupo sem contexto."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"All security checks passed with low risk score." to "Todas as verificações de segurança passaram com pontuação de risco baixa."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "O modo equilibrado usa heurísticas padrão. Sinaliza padrões maliciosos conhecidos e encurtadores de URL suspeitos."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Brand logo detected on landing page: Global Bank Ltd" to "Logo da marca detectado na página de destino: Global Bank Ltd"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Certificate Issuer matches domain owner (DigiCert Inc)." to "Emissor do certificado corresponde ao proprietário do domínio (DigiCert Inc)."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Changes apply immediately to navigation labels." to "Alterações se aplicam imediatamente às etiquetas de navegação."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "A execução de código acontece em um container efêmero. Payloads maliciosos nunca tocam o kernel do SO."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "A análise completa é realizada localmente. Sua câmera e dados escaneados nunca tocam um servidor externo, garantindo privacidade absoluta."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Configure output parameters for Scan ID #SCAN-%s" to "Configurar parâmetros de saída para ID de Varredura #SCAN-%s"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Corporate IT sent a reset notice using the official Google auth domain." to "O TI corporativo enviou um aviso de redefinição usando o domínio oficial de autenticação do Google."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Do not visit this URL. It shows strong phishing indicators." to "Não visite este URL. Mostra fortes indicadores de phishing."

Fornecemos análises heurísticas detalhadas de parâmetros de URL, redirecionamentos e payloads JavaScript."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "Encontrado em uma mesa no Starbeans Coffee. Oferecia um cupom de café grátis se eu fizesse login."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "Atalhos: Cmd/Ctrl+V colar URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, configurações, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navegar, Enter analisar, Escape voltar"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Let's Encrypt R3. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Let's Encrypt R3. Nota: SSL válido não garante legitimidade do site."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "O modo baixo reduz falsos positivos. Sinaliza apenas padrões maliciosos confirmados. Ideal para ambientes confiáveis."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "O modo baixo reduz falsos positivos. Sinaliza apenas padrões maliciosos confirmados. Melhor para ambientes confiáveis."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Majority vote determines verdict: 3+ SAFE = green, 2+ MAL = red" to "Voto majoritário determina o veredito: 3+ SEGURO = verde, 2+ MALICIOSO = vermelho"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "Gerencie heurísticas offline, políticas de retenção de dados e listas de domínios permitidos. Todas as alterações são aplicadas imediatamente."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Mixed script characters detected in domain name intended to spoof legitimate brands." to "Detectados caracteres de script misto no domínio para falsificar marcas legítimas."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "Esta URL parece segura para visitar. Nossa análise não detectou indicadores de phishing."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "Para escanear códigos QR diretamente, habilite o acesso à câmera no seu dispositivo ou use as opções de entrada manual abaixo."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Unable to fully analyze. Verify manually before visiting." to "Não foi possível analisar completamente. Verifique manualmente antes de visitar."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Update checks are not available in offline mode." to "Verificações de atualização não estão disponíveis no modo offline."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Use the search box to filter by domain, source, or hash" to "Use a caixa de pesquisa para filtrar por domínio, origem ou hash"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Certificado SSL válido presente. Nota: SSL válido não garante legitimidade do site."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Verified ownership by Microsoft Corporation via EV Certificate." to "Propriedade verificada pela Microsoft Corporation via Certificado EV."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "Desabilitamos rigorosamente a telemetria de saída para varreduras. Resultados de varredura e hashes de imagem permanecem locais."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to "Enquanto .com é padrão, a estrutura com hífen com \"support\" é comum em phishing."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsPt.kt$"Zero intermediate redirects found. Destination is final." to "Zero redirecionamentos intermediários encontrados. Destino é final."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"A shortened link shared in a group chat without context." to "Сокращённая ссылка поделена в групповом чате без контекста."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "Сбалансированный режим использует стандартные эвристики. Отмечает известные вредоносные паттерны и подозрительные сокращатели URL."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Brand logo detected on landing page: Global Bank Ltd" to "Логотип бренда обнаружен на целевой странице: Global Bank Ltd"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Caution Advised: Suspicious Activity Detected" to "Рекомендуется осторожность: обнаружена подозрительная активность"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Certificate Issuer matches domain owner (DigiCert Inc)." to "Издатель сертификата совпадает с владельцем домена (DigiCert Inc)."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "Выполнение кода происходит в эфемерном контейнере. Вредоносные нагрузки никогда не касаются ядра ОС."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "Полный анализ выполняется локально. Ваша камера и отсканированные данные никогда не попадают на внешний сервер, обеспечивая абсолютную конфиденциальность."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Corporate IT sent a reset notice using the official Google auth domain." to "Корпоративное IT отправило уведомление о сбросе через официальный домен аутентификации Google."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Do not visit this URL. It shows strong phishing indicators." to "Не посещайте этот URL. Он показывает сильные признаки фишинга."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Domain is not yet listed on major threat intelligence feeds." to "Домен ещё не внесён в основные источники информации об угрозах."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Domain registered > 20 years ago. High reputation score." to "Домен зарегистрирован > 20 лет назад. Высокий рейтинг репутации."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Domain uses Cyrillic characters to mimic legitimate Latin letters." to "Домен использует кириллические символы для имитации легитимных латинских букв."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Domain uses a standard top-level domain with good reputation." to "Домен использует стандартный TLD с хорошей репутацией."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Domain uses lookalike characters to mimic legitimate sites." to "Домен использует похожие символы для имитации легитимных сайтов."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Domain was registered today. Highly suspicious for banking services." to "Домен зарегистрирован сегодня. Крайне подозрительно для банковских сервисов."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "Не просто получите \"Блок\". Мы предоставляем подробный эвристический анализ параметров URL, перенаправлений и JavaScript-нагрузок."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "Нашёл это на столе в Starbeans Coffee. Предлагался бесплатный купон на кофе при входе."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Javascript-based redirection (obfuscates destination from crawlers)" to "JavaScript-перенаправление (скрывает назначение от краулеров)"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "Горячие клавиши: Cmd/Ctrl+V вставить URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, настройки, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 навигация, Enter анализ, Escape назад"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Learn how to identify advanced QR homograph attacks." to "Узнайте, как идентифицировать продвинутые омографические атаки QR."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Let's Encrypt R3. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Let's Encrypt R3. Примечание: действительный SSL не гарантирует легитимность сайта."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "Низкий режим уменьшает ложные срабатывания. Отмечает только подтверждённые вредоносные паттерны. Лучше для доверенных сред."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Majority vote determines verdict: 3+ SAFE = green, 2+ MAL = red" to "Большинство голосов определяет вердикт: 3+ БЕЗОПАСНО = зелёный, 2+ ВРЕДОНОСНО = красный"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "Управляйте офлайн-эвристиками, политиками хранения данных и белыми списками доменов. Все изменения применяются немедленно."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Mehr Guard analyses potential threats directly on your hardware. Experience zero-latency phishing detection without compromising data privacy." to "Mehr Guard анализирует потенциальные угрозы непосредственно на вашем оборудовании. MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to "Хотя .com стандартен, структура с дефисом и \"support\" распространена в фишинге."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsRu.kt$"Zero intermediate redirects found. Destination is final." to "Промежуточных перенаправлений не найдено. Пункт назначения окончательный."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "โหมดสมดุลใช้ฮิวริสติกมาตรฐาน ทำเครื่องหมายรูปแบบที่เป็นอันตรายที่รู้จักและตัวย่อ URL ที่น่าสงสัย"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "การเรียกใช้โค้ดเกิดขึ้นในคอนเทนเนอร์ชั่วคราว เพย์โหลดที่เป็นอันตรายไม่เคยแตะเคอร์เนล OS"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "การวิเคราะห์ทั้งหมดดำเนินการในเครื่อง ฟีดกล้องและข้อมูลที่สแกนของคุณไม่เคยไปถึงเซิร์ฟเวอร์ภายนอก รับประกันความเป็นส่วนตัวอย่างสมบูรณ์"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Corporate IT sent a reset notice using the official Google auth domain." to "IT องค์กรส่งการแจ้งเตือนรีเซ็ตโดยใช้โดเมนการยืนยันตัวตนอย่างเป็นทางการของ Google"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Do not visit this URL. It shows strong phishing indicators." to "อย่าเข้าชม URL นี้ มันแสดงตัวบ่งชี้ฟิชชิ่งที่แข็งแกร่ง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Domain uses Cyrillic characters to mimic legitimate Latin letters." to "โดเมนใช้อักขระซิริลลิกเพื่อเลียนแบบตัวอักษรละตินที่ถูกต้อง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Domain uses lookalike characters to mimic legitimate sites." to "โดเมนใช้อักขระที่คล้ายกันเพื่อเลียนแบบไซต์ที่ถูกต้อง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Domain was registered today. Highly suspicious for banking services." to "โดเมนถูกลงทะเบียนวันนี้ น่าสงสัยมากสำหรับบริการธนาคาร"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "อย่าแค่รับ \"บล็อก\" เราให้การวิเคราะห์ฮิวริสติกโดยละเอียดของพารามิเตอร์ URL การเปลี่ยนเส้นทาง และเพย์โหลด JavaScript"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "พบบนโต๊ะที่ Starbeans Coffee เสนอคูปองกาแฟฟรีถ้าเข้าสู่ระบบ"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Javascript-based redirection (obfuscates destination from crawlers)" to "การเปลี่ยนเส้นทางโดยใช้ JavaScript (ปิดบังปลายทางจาก crawlers)"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "ทางลัด: Cmd/Ctrl+V วาง URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, การตั้งค่า, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 นำทาง, Enter วิเคราะห์, Escape ย้อนกลับ"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Let's Encrypt R3. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Let's Encrypt R3 หมายเหตุ: SSL ที่ถูกต้องไม่รับประกันความถูกต้องของเว็บไซต์"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "โหมดต่ำลดผลบวกลวง ทำเครื่องหมายเฉพาะรูปแบบที่เป็นอันตรายที่ยืนยันแล้ว เหมาะสำหรับสภาพแวดล้อมที่น่าเชื่อถือ"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Majority vote determines verdict: 3+ SAFE = green, 2+ MAL = red" to "เสียงข้างมากกำหนดผล: 3+ ปลอดภัย=เขียว, 2+ อันตราย=แดง"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "จัดการฮิวริสติกออฟไลน์ นโยบายการเก็บข้อมูล และไวท์ลิสต์โดเมน การเปลี่ยนแปลงทั้งหมดมีผลทันที"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Mehr Guard analyses potential threats directly on your hardware. Experience zero-latency phishing detection without compromising data privacy." to "Mehr Guard วิเคราะห์ภัยคุกคามที่อาจเกิดขึ้นโดยตรงบนฮาร์ดแวร์ของคุณ สัมผัสการตรวจจับฟิชชิ่งแบบไม่มีความหน่วงโดยไม่กระทบต่อความเป็นส่วนตัวของข้อมูล"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. No image data, scanned URLs, or telemetry are sent to the cloud for analysis." to "Mehr Guard ทำงานบนฮาร์ดแวร์ในเครื่องของคุณทั้งหมด ไม่มีข้อมูลรูปภาพ URL ที่สแกน หรือการวัดระยะไกลถูกส่งไปยังคลาวด์เพื่อการวิเคราะห์"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. We prioritize explainable security with zero cloud telemetry for image analysis." to "Mehr Guard ประมวลผลทุกการสแกนภายใน sandbox ในเครื่องที่ปลอดภัยและแยกส่วน เราให้ความสำคัญกับความปลอดภัยที่อธิบายได้โดยไม่มีการส่งข้อมูลไปคลาวด์สำหรับการวิเคราะห์รูปภาพ"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Mixed script characters detected in domain name intended to spoof legitimate brands." to "ตรวจพบอักขระสคริปต์ผสมในชื่อโดเมนที่ตั้งใจเพื่อปลอมแปลงแบรนด์ที่ถูกต้อง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Multiple phishing indicators detected. See threat score for details." to "ตรวจพบตัวบ่งชี้ฟิชชิ่งหลายตัว ดูคะแนนภัยคุกคามสำหรับรายละเอียด"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"No mixed-script characters or IDN spoofing detected in domain string." to "ไม่พบอักขระสคริปต์ผสมหรือการปลอมแปลง IDN ในสตริงโดเมน"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Offline mode enabled. Disable Strict Offline Mode to open URLs." to "เปิดใช้งานโหมดออฟไลน์ ปิดใช้งานโหมดออฟไลน์เข้มงวดเพื่อเปิด URL"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Optimised for desktop environments. Scans are processed in under 5ms using native Kotlin Multiplatform binaries." to "ปรับให้เหมาะสำหรับสภาพแวดล้อมเดสก์ท็อป การสแกนประมวลผลใน 5 มิลลิวินาทีโดยใช้ไบนารี Kotlin Multiplatform"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Paranoia mode enables maximum scrutiny. All edge cases trigger warnings. Best for high-security needs." to "โหมดหวาดระแวงเปิดใช้งานการตรวจสอบสูงสุด ทุกกรณีขอบเขตจะเรียกใช้คำเตือน เหมาะสำหรับความต้องการด้านความปลอดภัยสูง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Proceed with caution. Verify the source before clicking." to "ดำเนินการด้วยความระมัดระวัง ตรวจสอบแหล่งที่มาก่อนคลิก"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Real-time audit logs of all QR code captures, including verdicts from the local heuristic engine." to "บันทึกการตรวจสอบแบบเรียลไทม์ของการจับ QR โค้ดทั้งหมด รวมถึงคำตัดสินจากเครื่องยนต์ฮิวริสติกในเครื่อง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Registered less than 48 hours ago via cheap registrar." to "จดทะเบียนน้อยกว่า 48 ชั่วโมงที่ผ่านมาผ่านผู้รับจดทะเบียนราคาถูก"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Score based on heuristic analysis of domain age, entropy, and keyword matching." to "คะแนนอิงจากการวิเคราะห์ฮิวริสติกของอายุโดเมน เอนโทรปี และการจับคู่คีย์เวิร์ด"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Secure HTTPS connection with encrypted data transfer." to "การเชื่อมต่อ HTTPS ที่ปลอดภัยพร้อมการถ่ายโอนข้อมูลที่เข้ารหัส"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The ML model classified this URL as benign with high certainty. The structure matches known legitimate authentication patterns." to "โมเดล ML จัดประเภท URL นี้ว่าไม่เป็นอันตรายด้วยความมั่นใจสูง โครงสร้างตรงกับรูปแบบการยืนยันตัวตนที่ถูกต้องที่รู้จัก"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The URL appears to impersonate a well-known brand, which is a common phishing tactic." to "URL ดูเหมือนจะแอบอ้างเป็นแบรนด์ที่รู้จักกันดี ซึ่งเป็นกลวิธีฟิชชิ่งทั่วไป"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The URL contains parameters that suggest credential harvesting." to "URL มีพารามิเตอร์ที่บ่งบอกถึงการเก็บข้อมูลรับรอง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The URL has an unusual number of subdomains, which can be used to mislead users." to "URL มีจำนวนซับโดเมนที่ผิดปกติ ซึ่งอาจใช้เพื่อหลอกลวงผู้ใช้"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The URL is unusually long, which can be used to hide the actual destination." to "URL ยาวผิดปกติ ซึ่งอาจใช้เพื่อซ่อนปลายทางจริง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The URL uses HTTP instead of HTTPS, meaning data is not encrypted." to "URL ใช้ HTTP แทน HTTPS หมายความว่าข้อมูลไม่ได้เข้ารหัส"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, which is unusual for legitimate sites." to "URL ใช้ที่อยู่ IP แทนชื่อโดเมน ซึ่งผิดปกติสำหรับเว็บไซต์ที่ถูกต้อง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The domain micros0ft-support.com uses a zero '0' instead of the letter 'o'." to "โดเมน micros0ft-support.com ใช้เลขศูนย์ '0' แทนตัวอักษร 'o'"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The domain uses a top-level domain commonly associated with malicious sites." to "โดเมนใช้ TLD ที่มักเกี่ยวข้องกับไซต์อันตราย"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "ฐานข้อมูลลายเซ็นภัยคุกคามทั้งหมดถูกดาวน์โหลดไปยังอุปกรณ์ของคุณสำหรับการค้นหาในระดับมิลลิวินาที"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"The scanned QR code redirects to a known phishing vector designed to harvest credentials." to "QR โค้ดที่สแกนเปลี่ยนเส้นทางไปยังเวกเตอร์ฟิชชิ่งที่รู้จักซึ่งออกแบบมาเพื่อเก็บเกี่ยวข้อมูลประจำตัว"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "URL นี้ดูเหมือนจะปลอดภัยที่จะเยี่ยมชม การวิเคราะห์ของเราไม่พบตัวบ่งชี้ฟิชชิ่ง"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"This URL appears to be safe with a risk score of %d. No significant phishing indicators were detected." to "URL นี้ดูเหมือนจะปลอดภัยด้วยคะแนนความเสี่ยง %d ไม่พบตัวบ่งชี้ฟิชชิ่งที่สำคัญ"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"This URL has some suspicious characteristics with a risk score of %d. Several potential phishing indicators were found." to "URL นี้มีลักษณะที่น่าสงสัยด้วยคะแนนความเสี่ยง %d พบตัวบ่งชี้ฟิชชิ่งที่อาจเป็นไปได้หลายตัว"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"This URL is likely malicious with a high risk score of %d. Multiple strong phishing indicators were detected." to "URL นี้น่าจะเป็นอันตรายด้วยคะแนนความเสี่ยงสูง %d พบตัวบ่งชี้ฟิชชิ่งที่แข็งแกร่งหลายตัว"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"This will permanently delete all scan records. This action cannot be undone." to "การดำเนินการนี้จะลบบันทึกการสแกนทั้งหมดอย่างถาวร ไม่สามารถยกเลิกการดำเนินการนี้ได้"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"This will reset all settings to their default values. Your scan history will not be affected." to "การดำเนินการนี้จะรีเซ็ตการตั้งค่าทั้งหมดเป็นค่าเริ่มต้น ประวัติการสแกนของคุณจะไม่ได้รับผลกระทบ"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "หากต้องการสแกน QR โค้ดโดยตรง กรุณาเปิดใช้งานการเข้าถึงกล้องบนอุปกรณ์ของคุณหรือใช้ตัวเลือกการป้อนข้อมูลด้วยตนเองด้านล่าง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"URL involves 3+ redirects through unrelated shortening services." to "URL เกี่ยวข้องกับการเปลี่ยนเส้นทาง 3+ ครั้งผ่านบริการย่อที่ไม่เกี่ยวข้อง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Unable to fully analyze. Verify manually before visiting." to "ไม่สามารถวิเคราะห์ได้อย่างสมบูรณ์ ตรวจสอบด้วยตนเองก่อนเข้าชม"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "มีใบรับรอง SSL ที่ถูกต้อง หมายเหตุ: SSL ที่ถูกต้องไม่รับประกันความถูกต้องของไซต์"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"Verified ownership by Microsoft Corporation via EV Certificate." to "ยืนยันความเป็นเจ้าของโดย Microsoft Corporation ผ่าน EV Certificate"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "เราปิดใช้งานการส่งข้อมูลออกสำหรับการสแกนอย่างเคร่งครัด ผลลัพธ์การสแกนและแฮชรูปภาพยังคงอยู่ในเครื่อง"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTh.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to "แม้ว่า .com จะเป็นมาตรฐาน แต่โครงสร้างที่มีขีดกลางกับ \"support\" พบได้บ่อยในฟิชชิ่ง"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"A shortened link shared in a group chat without context." to "Bağlam olmadan grup sohbetinde paylaşılan kısaltılmış bağlantı."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "Dengeli mod standart sezgisel analizler kullanır. Bilinen kötü amaçlı kalıpları ve şüpheli URL kısaltıcıları işaretler."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Brand logo detected on landing page: Global Bank Ltd" to "Açılış sayfasında marka logosu tespit edildi: Global Bank Ltd"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Certificate Issuer matches domain owner (DigiCert Inc)." to "Sertifika veren kuruluş alan adı sahibiyle eşleşiyor (DigiCert Inc)."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "Kod yürütme geçici bir konteyner içinde gerçekleşir. Kötü amaçlı yükler hiçbir zaman OS çekirdeğine dokunmaz."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "Tam analiz yerel olarak gerçekleştirilir. Kamera akışınız ve taranan veriler asla harici bir sunucuya ulaşmaz, mutlak gizlilik sağlar."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Configure output parameters for Scan ID #SCAN-%s" to "Tarama Kimliği #SCAN-%s için çıktı parametrelerini yapılandır"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Corporate IT sent a reset notice using the official Google auth domain." to "Kurumsal BT, resmi Google kimlik doğrulama alanını kullanarak sıfırlama bildirimi gönderdi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Do not visit this URL. It shows strong phishing indicators." to "Bu URL'yi ziyaret etmeyin. Güçlü oltalama göstergeleri gösteriyor."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Domain is not yet listed on major threat intelligence feeds." to "Alan adı henüz büyük tehdit istihbaratı akışlarında listelenmemiş."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Domain registered > 20 years ago. High reputation score." to "Alan adı > 20 yıl önce kaydedilmiş. Yüksek itibar puanı."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Domain uses Cyrillic characters to mimic legitimate Latin letters." to "Alan adı meşru Latin harflerini taklit etmek için Kiril karakterleri kullanıyor."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Domain uses a standard top-level domain with good reputation." to "Alan adı iyi itibarlı standart bir TLD kullanıyor."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Domain uses lookalike characters to mimic legitimate sites." to "Alan adı meşru siteleri taklit etmek için benzer karakterler kullanıyor."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Domain was registered today. Highly suspicious for banking services." to "Alan adı bugün kaydedildi. Bankacılık hizmetleri için oldukça şüpheli."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "Sadece \"Engelle\" almayın. URL parametreleri, yönlendirmeler ve JavaScript yüklerinin ayrıntılı sezgisel analizlerini sunuyoruz."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "Starbeans Coffee'de bir masada bulundu. Giriş yaparsam ücretsiz kahve kuponu teklif etti."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Javascript-based redirection (obfuscates destination from crawlers)" to "JavaScript tabanlı yönlendirme (hedefi tarayıcılardan gizler)"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "Kısayollar: Cmd/Ctrl+V URL yapıştır, Cmd/Ctrl+, ayarlar, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 gezin, Enter analiz, Escape geri"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Learn how to identify advanced QR homograph attacks." to "Gelişmiş QR homograf saldırılarını nasıl tanımlayacağınızı öğrenin."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Let's Encrypt R3. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Let's Encrypt R3. Not: Geçerli SSL site meşruiyetini garanti etmez."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "Düşük mod yanlış pozitifleri azaltır. Sadece onaylanmış kötü amaçlı kalıpları işaretler. Güvenilir ortamlar için en iyisi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Majority vote determines verdict: 3+ SAFE = green, 2+ MAL = red" to "Çoğunluk oyu kararı belirler: 3+ GÜVENLİ = yeşil, 2+ ZARARLI = kırmızı"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "Çevrimdışı sezgisel analizleri, veri saklama politikalarını ve alan adı beyaz listelerini yönetin. Tüm değişiklikler hemen uygulanır."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Mehr Guard analyses potential threats directly on your hardware. Experience zero-latency phishing detection without compromising data privacy." to "Mehr Guard potansiyel tehditleri doğrudan donanımınızda analiz eder. Veri gizliliğinden ödün vermeden sıfır gecikmeli oltalama tespiti deneyimleyin."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. No image data, scanned URLs, or telemetry are sent to the cloud for analysis." to "Mehr Guard tamamen yerel donanımınızda çalışır. Hiçbir görsel verisi, taranan URL veya telemetri analiz için buluta gönderilmez."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. We prioritize explainable security with zero cloud telemetry for image analysis." to "Mehr Guard her taramayı güvenli, yalıtılmış yerel sandbox içinde işler. Görsel analizi için sıfır bulut telemetrisi ile açıklanabilir güvenliğe öncelik veriyoruz."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Mixed script characters detected in domain name intended to spoof legitimate brands." to "Meşru markaları taklit etmek için alan adında karışık script karakterleri tespit edildi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Multiple phishing indicators detected. See threat score for details." to "Birden fazla oltalama göstergesi tespit edildi. Ayrıntılar için tehdit puanına bakın."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"No mixed-script characters or IDN spoofing detected in domain string." to "Alan adı dizesinde karışık script karakterleri veya IDN sahteciliği tespit edilmedi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"No scan history yet. Run a scan to populate results." to "Henüz tarama geçmişi yok. Sonuçları doldurmak için bir tarama çalıştırın."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"OAuth endpoint uses a trusted, well-known domain." to "OAuth uç noktası güvenilir, tanınmış bir alan adı kullanıyor."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Offline mode enabled. Disable Strict Offline Mode to open URLs." to "Çevrimdışı mod etkin. URL'leri açmak için Sıkı Çevrimdışı Modu devre dışı bırakın."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Optimised for desktop environments. Scans are processed in under 5ms using native Kotlin Multiplatform binaries." to "Masaüstü ortamları için optimize edildi. Taramalar yerel Kotlin Multiplatform ikili dosyaları kullanılarak 5ms'nin altında işlenir."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Paranoia mode enables maximum scrutiny. All edge cases trigger warnings. Best for high-security needs." to "Paranoya modu maksimum incelemeyi etkinleştirir. Tüm uç durumlar uyarı tetikler. Yüksek güvenlik ihtiyaçları için en iyisi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Paste URL to analyze (e.g., https://example.com)" to "Analiz etmek için URL yapıştırın (örn., https://example.com)"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Proceed with caution. Verify the source before clicking." to "Dikkatli ilerleyin. Tıklamadan önce kaynağı doğrulayın."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Real-time audit logs of all QR code captures, including verdicts from the local heuristic engine." to "Yerel sezgisel motordan gelen kararlar dahil tüm QR kod yakalamalarının gerçek zamanlı denetim günlükleri."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Registered less than 48 hours ago via cheap registrar." to "48 saatten kısa süre önce ucuz kayıt şirketi aracılığıyla kaydedildi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Scan complete. Review the result screen for details." to "Tarama tamamlandı. Ayrıntılar için sonuç ekranını inceleyin."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Scanning for QR codes. Hold the code steady within the frame." to "QR kodları taranıyor. Kodu çerçeve içinde sabit tutun."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Score based on heuristic analysis of domain age, entropy, and keyword matching." to "Alan adı yaşı, entropi ve anahtar kelime eşleştirmesinin sezgisel analizine dayalı puan."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Simulates secure-login.com (Levenshtein Distance: 2)" to "secure-login.com'u simüle eder (Levenshtein Mesafesi: 2)"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The ML model classified this URL as benign with high certainty. The structure matches known legitimate authentication patterns." to "ML modeli bu URL'yi yüksek kesinlikle zararsız olarak sınıflandırdı. Yapı bilinen meşru kimlik doğrulama kalıplarıyla eşleşiyor."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL appears to impersonate a well-known brand, which is a common phishing tactic." to "URL bilinen bir markayı taklit ediyor gibi görünüyor, bu yaygın bir oltalama taktiğidir."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL contains parameters that suggest credential harvesting." to "URL, kimlik bilgisi toplama önerilen parametreler içeriyor."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL has an unusual number of subdomains, which can be used to mislead users." to "URL'de alışılmadık sayıda alt alan adı var, bu kullanıcıları yanıltmak için kullanılabilir."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL is unusually long, which can be used to hide the actual destination." to "URL olağandışı uzun, bu gerçek hedefi gizlemek için kullanılabilir."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL uses HTTP instead of HTTPS, meaning data is not encrypted." to "URL, HTTPS yerine HTTP kullanıyor, yani veriler şifrelenmemiş."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL uses a shortening service, hiding the actual destination." to "URL kısaltma hizmeti kullanıyor, gerçek hedefi gizliyor."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, which is unusual for legitimate sites." to "URL, alan adı yerine IP adresi kullanıyor, bu meşru siteler için alışılmadık bir durum."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The \"free coupon\" promise creates urgency and incentive." to "\"Ücretsiz kupon\" vaadi aciliyet ve teşvik yaratır."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The domain micros0ft-support.com uses a zero '0' instead of the letter 'o'." to "micros0ft-support.com alan adı 'o' harfi yerine sıfır '0' kullanıyor."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The domain uses a top-level domain commonly associated with malicious sites." to "Alan adı, kötü amaçlı sitelerle yaygın olarak ilişkilendirilen bir TLD kullanıyor."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "Tüm tehdit imza veritabanı milisaniye aramalar için cihazınıza indirilir."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"The scanned QR code redirects to a known phishing vector designed to harvest credentials." to "Taranan QR kodu, kimlik bilgilerini toplamak için tasarlanmış bilinen bir oltalama vektörüne yönlendiriyor."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "Bu URL ziyaret etmek için güvenli görünüyor. Analizimiz hiçbir oltalama göstergesi tespit etmedi."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"This URL appears to be safe with a risk score of %d. No significant phishing indicators were detected." to "Bu URL %d risk puanıyla güvenli görünüyor. Önemli oltalama göstergeleri tespit edilmedi."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"This URL has some suspicious characteristics with a risk score of %d. Several potential phishing indicators were found." to "Bu URL %d risk puanıyla şüpheli özelliklere sahip. Birkaç potansiyel oltalama göstergesi bulundu."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"This URL is likely malicious with a high risk score of %d. Multiple strong phishing indicators were detected." to "Bu URL yüksek risk puanı %d ile muhtemelen zararlı. Birden fazla güçlü oltalama göstergesi tespit edildi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"This will permanently delete all scan records. This action cannot be undone." to "Bu, tüm tarama kayıtlarını kalıcı olarak silecektir. Bu işlem geri alınamaz."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"This will reset all settings to their default values. Your scan history will not be affected." to "Bu, tüm ayarları varsayılan değerlerine sıfırlayacaktır. Tarama geçmişiniz etkilenmeyecektir."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "QR kodlarını doğrudan taramak için lütfen cihazınızda kamera erişimini etkinleştirin veya aşağıdaki manuel giriş seçeneklerini kullanın."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"URL involves 3+ redirects through unrelated shortening services." to "URL, ilgisiz kısaltma hizmetleri aracılığıyla 3+ yönlendirme içeriyor."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Unable to fully analyze. Verify manually before visiting." to "Tam olarak analiz edilemiyor. Ziyaret etmeden önce manuel olarak doğrulayın."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Use the search box to filter by domain, source, or hash" to "Alan adı, kaynak veya hash'e göre filtrelemek için arama kutusunu kullanın"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Geçerli SSL sertifikası mevcut. Not: Geçerli SSL site meşruiyetini garanti etmez."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"Verified ownership by Microsoft Corporation via EV Certificate." to "Microsoft Corporation tarafından EV Sertifikası ile doğrulanmış sahiplik."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "Taramalar için giden telemetriyi kesinlikle devre dışı bırakıyoruz. Tarama sonuçları ve görsel hash'leri yerel kalır."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsTr.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to ".com standart olsa da, \"support\" ile tireli yapı oltalamalarda yaygındır."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"A shortened link shared in a group chat without context." to "Liên kết rút gọn được chia sẻ trong nhóm chat mà không có ngữ cảnh."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "Chế độ cân bằng sử dụng heuristics tiêu chuẩn. Đánh dấu các mẫu độc hại đã biết và trình rút gọn URL đáng nghi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Brand logo detected on landing page: Global Bank Ltd" to "Phát hiện logo thương hiệu trên trang đích: Global Bank Ltd"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Certificate Issuer matches domain owner (DigiCert Inc)." to "Nhà phát hành chứng chỉ khớp với chủ sở hữu tên miền (DigiCert Inc)."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "Thực thi mã xảy ra trong container tạm thời. Payload độc hại không bao giờ chạm đến kernel OS."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "Phân tích hoàn chỉnh được thực hiện cục bộ. Nguồn cấp camera và dữ liệu quét của bạn không bao giờ chạm đến máy chủ bên ngoài, đảm bảo quyền riêng tư tuyệt đối."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Corporate IT sent a reset notice using the official Google auth domain." to "IT công ty đã gửi thông báo đặt lại bằng tên miền xác thực chính thức của Google."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Do not visit this URL. It shows strong phishing indicators." to "Không truy cập URL này. Nó cho thấy các chỉ báo lừa đảo mạnh."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Domain is not yet listed on major threat intelligence feeds." to "Tên miền chưa được liệt kê trên các nguồn tin tình báo mối đe dọa chính."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Domain uses Cyrillic characters to mimic legitimate Latin letters." to "Tên miền sử dụng ký tự Cyrillic để bắt chước chữ cái Latin hợp pháp."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Domain uses lookalike characters to mimic legitimate sites." to "Tên miền sử dụng ký tự tương tự để bắt chước trang hợp pháp."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Domain was registered today. Highly suspicious for banking services." to "Tên miền được đăng ký hôm nay. Rất đáng nghi cho dịch vụ ngân hàng."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "Đừng chỉ nhận \"Chặn\". Chúng tôi cung cấp phân tích heuristic chi tiết về các tham số URL, chuyển hướng và payload JavaScript."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "Tìm thấy trên bàn tại Starbeans Coffee. Nó đề nghị phiếu giảm giá cà phê miễn phí nếu tôi đăng nhập."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Full heuristic and ML analysis completed successfully." to "Phân tích heuristic và ML đầy đủ hoàn thành thành công."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Javascript-based redirection (obfuscates destination from crawlers)" to "Chuyển hướng dựa trên JavaScript (che giấu đích đến khỏi crawlers)"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "Phím tắt: Cmd/Ctrl+V dán URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, cài đặt, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 điều hướng, Enter phân tích, Escape quay lại"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Learn how to identify advanced QR homograph attacks." to "Tìm hiểu cách nhận dạng các cuộc tấn công homograph QR nâng cao."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Let's Encrypt R3. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Let's Encrypt R3. Lưu ý: SSL hợp lệ không đảm bảo tính hợp pháp của trang web."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "Chế độ thấp giảm dương tính giả. Chỉ đánh dấu các mẫu độc hại đã xác nhận. Tốt nhất cho môi trường tin cậy."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Majority vote determines verdict: 3+ SAFE = green, 2+ MAL = red" to "Đa số phiếu quyết định kết quả: 3+ AN TOÀN = xanh, 2+ ĐỘC HẠI = đỏ"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "Quản lý heuristics ngoại tuyến, chính sách lưu giữ dữ liệu và danh sách trắng tên miền. Tất cả thay đổi áp dụng ngay lập tức."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Mehr Guard analyses potential threats directly on your hardware. Experience zero-latency phishing detection without compromising data privacy." to "Mehr Guard phân tích các mối đe dọa tiềm ẩn trực tiếp trên phần cứng của bạn. Trải nghiệm phát hiện lừa đảo không độ trễ mà không ảnh hưởng đến quyền riêng tư dữ liệu."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. No image data, scanned URLs, or telemetry are sent to the cloud for analysis." to "Mehr Guard hoạt động hoàn toàn trên phần cứng cục bộ của bạn. Không có dữ liệu hình ảnh, URL đã quét hoặc đo từ xa được gửi lên cloud để phân tích."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. We prioritize explainable security with zero cloud telemetry for image analysis." to "Mehr Guard xử lý mọi lần quét trong sandbox cục bộ an toàn, cô lập. Chúng tôi ưu tiên bảo mật có thể giải thích với zero telemetry cloud cho phân tích hình ảnh."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Mixed script characters detected in domain name intended to spoof legitimate brands." to "Phát hiện ký tự script hỗn hợp trong tên miền nhằm giả mạo thương hiệu hợp pháp."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Multiple phishing indicators detected. See threat score for details." to "Phát hiện nhiều chỉ số lừa đảo. Xem điểm đe dọa để biết chi tiết."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"No mixed-script characters or IDN spoofing detected in domain string." to "Không phát hiện ký tự script hỗn hợp hoặc giả mạo IDN trong chuỗi tên miền."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Offline mode enabled. Disable Strict Offline Mode to open URLs." to "Chế độ ngoại tuyến đã bật. Tắt Chế Độ Ngoại Tuyến Nghiêm Ngặt để mở URL."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Optimised for desktop environments. Scans are processed in under 5ms using native Kotlin Multiplatform binaries." to "Được tối ưu hóa cho môi trường desktop. Quét được xử lý trong dưới 5ms sử dụng các tệp nhị phân Kotlin Multiplatform gốc."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Paranoia mode enables maximum scrutiny. All edge cases trigger warnings. Best for high-security needs." to "Chế độ hoang tưởng cho phép kiểm tra tối đa. Tất cả các trường hợp cận biên kích hoạt cảnh báo. Tốt nhất cho nhu cầu bảo mật cao."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Real-time QR code analysis and threat detection." to "Phân tích mã QR theo thời gian thực và phát hiện mối đe dọa."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Real-time audit logs of all QR code captures, including verdicts from the local heuristic engine." to "Nhật ký kiểm toán thời gian thực của tất cả các lần chụp mã QR, bao gồm các phán quyết từ động cơ heuristic cục bộ."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Registered less than 48 hours ago via cheap registrar." to "Đăng ký cách đây chưa đến 48 giờ qua nhà đăng ký giá rẻ."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Sandbox rendered. No active scripts executed." to "Sandbox đã render. Không có script hoạt động nào được thực thi."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Score based on heuristic analysis of domain age, entropy, and keyword matching." to "Điểm dựa trên phân tích heuristic về tuổi tên miền, entropy và khớp từ khóa."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The ML model classified this URL as benign with high certainty. The structure matches known legitimate authentication patterns." to "Mô hình ML phân loại URL này là lành tính với độ chắc chắn cao. Cấu trúc khớp với các mẫu xác thực hợp pháp đã biết."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The URL appears to impersonate a well-known brand, which is a common phishing tactic." to "URL dường như mạo danh một thương hiệu nổi tiếng, đây là chiến thuật lừa đảo phổ biến."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The URL contains parameters that suggest credential harvesting." to "URL chứa các tham số gợi ý thu thập thông tin xác thực."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The URL has an unusual number of subdomains, which can be used to mislead users." to "URL có số lượng tên miền phụ bất thường, có thể được sử dụng để đánh lừa người dùng."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The URL is unusually long, which can be used to hide the actual destination." to "URL dài bất thường, có thể được sử dụng để ẩn đích thực."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The URL uses HTTP instead of HTTPS, meaning data is not encrypted." to "URL sử dụng HTTP thay vì HTTPS, có nghĩa là dữ liệu không được mã hóa."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, which is unusual for legitimate sites." to "URL sử dụng địa chỉ IP thay vì tên miền, điều này bất thường đối với các trang web hợp pháp."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The \"free coupon\" promise creates urgency and incentive." to "Lời hứa \"phiếu giảm giá miễn phí\" tạo ra sự cấp bách và động lực."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The domain micros0ft-support.com uses a zero '0' instead of the letter 'o'." to "Tên miền micros0ft-support.com sử dụng số không '0' thay vì chữ cái 'o'."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The domain uses a top-level domain commonly associated with malicious sites." to "Tên miền sử dụng TLD thường liên quan đến các trang web độc hại."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "Toàn bộ cơ sở dữ liệu chữ ký mối đe dọa được tải xuống thiết bị của bạn để tra cứu trong mili giây."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"The scanned QR code redirects to a known phishing vector designed to harvest credentials." to "Mã QR đã quét chuyển hướng đến vector lừa đảo đã biết được thiết kế để thu thập thông tin đăng nhập."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "URL này có vẻ an toàn để truy cập. Phân tích của chúng tôi không phát hiện chỉ số lừa đảo nào."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"This URL appears to be safe with a risk score of %d. No significant phishing indicators were detected." to "URL này có vẻ an toàn với điểm rủi ro %d. Không phát hiện chỉ số lừa đảo đáng kể."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"This URL has some suspicious characteristics with a risk score of %d. Several potential phishing indicators were found." to "URL này có đặc điểm đáng ngờ với điểm rủi ro %d. Phát hiện một số chỉ số lừa đảo tiềm năng."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"This URL is likely malicious with a high risk score of %d. Multiple strong phishing indicators were detected." to "URL này có thể độc hại với điểm rủi ro cao %d. Phát hiện nhiều chỉ số lừa đảo mạnh."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"This will permanently delete all scan records. This action cannot be undone." to "Thao tác này sẽ xóa vĩnh viễn tất cả các bản ghi quét. Hành động này không thể hoàn tác."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"This will reset all settings to their default values. Your scan history will not be affected." to "Điều này sẽ đặt lại tất cả cài đặt về giá trị mặc định. Lịch sử quét của bạn sẽ không bị ảnh hưởng."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "Để quét mã QR trực tiếp, vui lòng bật quyền truy cập camera trên thiết bị của bạn hoặc sử dụng các tùy chọn nhập thủ công bên dưới."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"URL involves 3+ redirects through unrelated shortening services." to "URL liên quan đến 3+ chuyển hướng qua các dịch vụ rút gọn không liên quan."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Unable to fully analyze. Verify manually before visiting." to "Không thể phân tích đầy đủ. Xác minh thủ công trước khi truy cập."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Use the search box to filter by domain, source, or hash" to "Sử dụng hộp tìm kiếm để lọc theo tên miền, nguồn hoặc hash"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "Có chứng chỉ SSL hợp lệ. Lưu ý: SSL hợp lệ không đảm bảo tính hợp pháp của trang web."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Verified ownership by Microsoft Corporation via EV Certificate." to "Xác minh quyền sở hữu bởi Microsoft Corporation qua EV Certificate."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "Chúng tôi nghiêm ngặt tắt telemetry đi ra cho các lần quét. Kết quả quét và hash hình ảnh vẫn ở cục bộ."

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to "Mặc dù .com là tiêu chuẩn, cấu trúc có dấu gạch nối với \"support\" phổ biến trong lừa đảo."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsVi.kt$"Zero intermediate redirects found. Destination is final." to "Không tìm thấy chuyển hướng trung gian. Đích là cuối cùng."
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Balanced mode uses standard heuristics. Flags known malicious patterns and suspicious URL shorteners." to "平衡模式使用标准启发式。标记已知的恶意模式和可疑的URL缩短器。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch an OS kernel." to "代码执行在临时容器中进行。恶意负载永远不会触及操作系统内核。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "分析完全在本地完成。摄像头画面和扫描数据不会触达外部服务器，确保绝对隐私。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "不仅仅是“拦截”。我们提供 URL 参数、重定向和 JavaScript 载荷的详细启发式解析。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Found this on a table at Starbeans Coffee. It offered a free coffee coupon if I logged in." to "在星豆咖啡的桌上发现。提示登录即可获得免费咖啡券。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Keyboard shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+V paste URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, settings, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 navigate, Enter analyze, Escape go back" to "快捷键: Cmd/Ctrl+V 粘贴URL, Cmd/Ctrl+, 设置, Cmd/Ctrl+1-4 导航, Enter 分析, Escape 返回"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Low mode reduces false positives. Only flags confirmed malicious patterns. Best for trusted environments." to "低模式减少误报。仅标记已确认的恶意模式。最适合受信任的环境。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "管理离线启发式、数据保留政策和域名白名单。所有更改立即生效。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Manage offline heuristics, data retention policies, and domain allowlists. All changes apply immediately." to "管理离线启发式、数据保留策略和域白名单。所有更改立即生效。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard analyses potential threats directly on your hardware. Experience zero-latency phishing detection without compromising data privacy." to "Mehr Guard 在本机硬件上直接分析潜在威胁，实现零延迟的钓鱼检测且不牺牲数据隐私。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. No image data, scanned URLs, or telemetry are sent to the cloud for analysis." to "Mehr Guard 完全在本地硬件上运行。不会将图像数据、扫描的 URL 或遥测数据发送到云端进行分析。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard operates entirely on your local hardware. No image data, scanned URLs, or telemetry are sent to the cloud for analysis." to "Mehr Guard完全在本地硬件上运行。没有图像数据、扫描的URL或遥测被发送到云进行分析。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. We prioritize explainable security with zero cloud telemetry for image analysis." to "Mehr Guard在安全、隔离的本地沙箱中处理每次扫描。我们优先考虑可解释的安全性，图像分析零云遥测。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Optimised for desktop environments. Scans are processed in under 5ms using native Kotlin Multiplatform binaries." to "针对桌面环境优化。扫描在 5 毫秒内完成，使用 Kotlin Multiplatform 原生二进制。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Paranoia mode enables maximum scrutiny. All edge cases trigger warnings. Best for high-security needs." to "偏执模式启用最大审查。所有边缘情况触发警告。最适合高安全需求。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Real-time audit logs of all QR code captures, including verdicts from the local heuristic engine." to "所有二维码捕获的实时审计日志，包括本地启发式引擎的判定。"

MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"The ML model classified this URL as benign with high certainty. The structure matches known legitimate authentication patterns." to "ML 模型以高置信度判定该 URL 为良性。结构符合已知的合法认证模式。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"The URL appears to impersonate a well-known brand, which is a common phishing tactic." to "该URL似乎在冒充知名品牌，这是常见的钓鱼手法。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"The URL uses an IP address instead of a domain name, which is unusual for legitimate sites." to "URL使用IP地址而非域名，这对于合法网站来说是不寻常的。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"The domain micros0ft-support.com uses a zero '0' instead of the letter 'o'." to "域名 micros0ft-support.com 使用数字“0”替代字母“o”。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "整个威胁签名数据库下载到您的设备以进行毫秒级查找。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"The scanned QR code redirects to a known phishing vector designed to harvest credentials." to "扫描的二维码重定向到一个已知的钓鱼向量，旨在收集凭证。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"This URL appears safe to visit. Our analysis did not detect any phishing indicators." to "该URL似乎可以安全访问。我们的分析未检测到钓鱼指标。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"This URL appears to be safe with a risk score of %d. No significant phishing indicators were detected." to "此URL风险评分为%d，看起来是安全的。未检测到重大钓鱼指标。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"This URL has some suspicious characteristics with a risk score of %d. Several potential phishing indicators were found." to "此URL风险评分为%d，具有一些可疑特征。发现了几个潜在的钓鱼指标。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"This URL is likely malicious with a high risk score of %d. Multiple strong phishing indicators were detected." to "此URL高风险评分为%d，可能是恶意的。检测到多个强烈的钓鱼指标。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"This will reset all settings to their default values. Your scan history will not be affected." to "这将把所有设置重置为默认值。您的扫描历史不会受到影响。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"To scan QR codes directly, please enable camera access on your device or use the manual input options below." to "如需直接扫描二维码，请启用设备摄像头权限，或使用下方手动输入选项。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"Valid SSL certificate present. Note: Valid SSL does not guarantee site legitimacy." to "存在有效SSL证书。注意：有效SSL不保证网站合法性。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "我们严格禁用扫描的外发遥测。扫描结果和图像哈希保持本地。"
MaxLineLength:DesktopStringsZh.kt$"While .com is standard, the hyphenated structure with \"support\" is common in phishing." to "虽然 .com 很常见，但带有 “support” 的连字符结构常见于钓鱼。"
