MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.FeatureExplainableDesc to "อย่าแค่รับ \"บล็อก\" เราให้การวิเคราะห์ฮิวริสติกโดยละเอียดของพารามิเตอร์ URL การเปลี่ยนเส้นทาง และเพย์โหลด JavaScript"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.FeatureOfflineDesc to "การวิเคราะห์ทั้งหมดดำเนินการในเครื่อง ฟีดกล้องและข้อมูลที่สแกนของคุณไม่เคยไปถึงเซิร์ฟเวอร์ภายนอก รับประกันความเป็นส่วนตัวอย่างสมบูรณ์"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.FeaturePerformanceDesc to "ปรับให้เหมาะสำหรับสภาพแวดล้อมเดสก์ท็อป การสแกนประมวลผลโดยใช้ไบนารี Kotlin Multiplatform"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.HeroDescription to "Mehr Guard วิเคราะห์ภัยคุกคามที่อาจเกิดขึ้นโดยตรงบนฮาร์ดแวร์ของคุณ สัมผัสการป้องกันที่ไม่มีความหน่วง"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.LowSensitivityModeDesc to "บล็อกเฉพาะ URL ที่เป็นอันตรายที่รู้จักจากฐานข้อมูลภัยคุกคาม ผลบวกปลอมน้อยที่สุด แต่อาจพลาดการโจมตีใหม่"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.MetaOfflineGuaranteeDesc to "รูปภาพนี้ถูกวิเคราะห์ในเครื่องบนอุปกรณ์ของคุณ ไม่มีข้อมูลถูกส่งไปยังคลาวด์สำหรับคำตัดสินนี้"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.MixedScriptAttackDesc to "โดเมนมีอักขระจากหลายสคริปต์ (เช่น ซีริลลิก + ละติน) พบบ่อยในการโจมตีโฮโมกราฟ"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.OfflineGuaranteeDesc to "การวิเคราะห์ Mehr Guard ทำงานทั้งหมดบน Neural Engine ของอุปกรณ์ ข้อมูล URL ไม่เคยออกจากโทรศัพท์ของคุณ"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.ParanoiaModeDesc to "การป้องกันสูงสุด บล็อกรูปแบบที่น่าสงสัยทั้งหมดรวมถึงโดเมนที่ลงทะเบียนใหม่ TLD ที่ไม่ปกติ และ URL ที่มีเทคนิคการเข้ารหัสที่อาจเป็นปัญหา"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.PrivacyGuaranteeDesc to "Mehr Guard ใช้เอ็นจิ้นวิเคราะห์ฮิวริสติกในเครื่อง ไม่มีข้อมูลรูปภาพ สตริง URL หรือเมตาดาต้าออกจากอุปกรณ์นี้ระหว่างการสแกน ความเป็นส่วนตัวของคุณได้รับการรับประกันทางคณิตศาสตร์"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.ProceedWithCautionDesc to "ตรวจพบตัวบ่งชี้ที่น่าสงสัยบางรายการ โปรดตรวจสอบแหล่งที่มาก่อนป้อนข้อมูลที่ละเอียดอ่อน"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.RestrictedDesc to "URL นี้ถูกทำเครื่องหมายว่าอาจเป็นอันตราย ตรวจสอบการวิเคราะห์ด้านล่างก่อนดำเนินการต่อ"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.SafeToVisitDesc to "ตรวจสอบโดยฮิวริสติกในเครื่อง v2.4 ไม่พบรูปแบบฟิชชิ่ง สคริปต์ที่ซ่อน หรือการจับคู่บัญชีดำ"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictDangerousDesc to "QR โค้ดที่สแกนมีตัวบ่งชี้อันตรายที่เกี่ยวข้องกับฟิชชิ่งและการเก็บเกี่ยวข้อมูลรับรอง อย่าดำเนินการต่อไปยัง URL เป้าหมาย"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictMinorConcernsDesc to "พบข้อกังวลด้านความปลอดภัยเล็กน้อย ลิงก์ดูปลอดภัยเป็นส่วนใหญ่แต่แนะนำให้ตรวจสอบ"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictSuspiciousDesc to "QR โค้ดที่สแกนแสดงรูปแบบที่น่าสงสัยซึ่งอาจบ่งบอกถึงความเสี่ยงด้านความปลอดภัย โปรดดำเนินการด้วยความระมัดระวัง"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTh.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictVerifiedSafeDesc to "ไม่พบภัยคุกคามด้านความปลอดภัย QR โค้ดนำไปสู่ปลายทางที่ตรวจสอบแล้วว่าปลอดภัย"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.AttackHomographExplain to "Alan adı Latin 'a' (U+0061) yerine Kiril 'а' (U+0430) kullanıyor. Bu teknik genellikle kullanıcıları meşru bir hizmeti ziyaret ettiklerine inandırmak için kullanılır."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.CameraAccessDescription to "Taramaya başlamak için buraya bir QR kod görseli sürükleyip bırakın veya kamera erişimini etkinleştirin."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.DangerousWarning to "Bu URL potansiyel olarak tehlikeli olarak işaretlendi. Açmak sizi oltalama, kötü amaçlı yazılım veya diğer güvenlik tehditlerine maruz bırakabilir. Devam etmek istediğinizden emin misiniz?"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.DoNotVisitDesc to "Yüksek güvenilirlikli oltalama tespit edildi. Bu URL birden fazla kötü amaçlı gösterge sergiliyor."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.DomainUsesInternationalChars to "Bu alan adı, meşru alan adlarını taklit edebilecek uluslararası karakterler kullanıyor."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.FeatureExplainableDesc to "Sadece \"Engelle\" almayın. URL parametreleri, yönlendirmeler ve JavaScript yüklerinin ayrıntılı sezgisel analizlerini sunuyoruz."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.FeatureOfflineDesc to "Tam analiz yerel olarak gerçekleştirilir. Kamera akışınız ve taranan veriler asla harici bir sunucuya ulaşmaz, mutlak gizlilik sağlar."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.FeaturePerformanceDesc to "Masaüstü ortamları için optimize edildi. Taramalar yerel Kotlin Multiplatform ikili dosyaları kullanılarak işlenir."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.HeroDescription to "Mehr Guard potansiyel tehditleri doğrudan donanımınızda analiz eder. Sıfır gecikme korumasını deneyimleyin."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.HeuristicAnalysisDesc to "URL, analiz motoru tarafından tespit edilen birden fazla risk faktörüne göre işaretlendi."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.LowSensitivityModeDesc to "Yalnızca tehdit veritabanından bilinen kötü amaçlı URL'leri engeller. Minimum yanlış pozitif, ancak yeni saldırıları kaçırabilir."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.MetaOfflineGuaranteeDesc to "Bu görsel cihazınızda yerel olarak analiz edildi. Bu karar için buluta veri gönderilmedi."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.MixedScriptAttackDesc to "Alan adı birden fazla yazı sisteminden karakterler içeriyor (örn. Kiril + Latin). Homograf saldırılarında yaygın."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.NoScanDataResults to "Tarama verisi mevcut değil. Analiz sonuçlarını görmek için lütfen bir URL tarayın."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.OfflineGuaranteeDesc to "Mehr Guard analizi tamamen cihazınızın Neural Engine'inde çalışır. URL verileri asla telefonunuzdan çıkmaz."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.ParanoiaModeDesc to "Maksimum koruma. Yeni kayıtlı alan adları, yaygın olmayan TLD'ler ve potansiyel kodlama hileleri içeren tüm şüpheli kalıpları engeller."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.PrivacyGuaranteeDesc to "Mehr Guard yerel sezgisel analiz motorları kullanır. Tarama sırasında hiçbir görüntü verisi, URL dizesi veya meta veri bu cihazdan ayrılmaz. Gizliliğiniz matematiksel olarak garanti edilir."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.ProceedWithCautionDesc to "Bazı şüpheli göstergeler tespit edildi. Hassas bilgi girmeden önce kaynağı doğrulayın."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.ReasonAtSymbolInjectionDesc to "URL, olası kimlik bilgisi hırsızlığı girişimini gösteren @ sembolü içeriyor"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.ReasonCredentialParamDesc to "URL, kimlik bilgileriyle ilgili parametreler içeriyor (şifre, token vb.)"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.ReasonMixedScriptDesc to "Ana bilgisayar adı birden fazla script'ten karakterler içeriyor (olası sahtekarlık)"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.ReasonZeroWidthCharsDesc to "Gizli sıfır genişlikli Unicode karakterler tespit edildi (gizleme girişimi)"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.RestrictedDesc to "Bu URL potansiyel olarak tehlikeli olarak işaretlendi. Devam etmeden önce aşağıdaki analizi inceleyin."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.SafeToVisitDesc to "Yerel sezgisel v2.4 tarafından doğrulandı. Oltalama deseni, gizlenmiş betik veya kara liste eşleşmesi bulunamadı."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.SettingsSavedAutomatically to "Ayarlar otomatik olarak kaydedilir ve oturumlar arasında senkronize edilir."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.SuspiciousTldDesc to "Alan adı, genellikle kötü amaçlı sitelerle ilişkilendirilen {tld} TLD kullanıyor."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictDangerousDesc to "Taranan QR kodu, oltalama ve kimlik bilgisi toplama ile ilişkili kötü amaçlı göstergeler içeriyor. Hedef URL'ye devam etmeyin."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictMinorConcernsDesc to "Bazı küçük güvenlik endişeleri belirlendi. Bağlantı çoğunlukla güvenli görünüyor ancak inceleme önerilir."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictNoActivityDesc to "Tarama verisi mevcut değil. Lütfen bir QR kod tarayın veya analiz için URL girin."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictSuspiciousDesc to "Taranan QR kod, potansiyel güvenlik risklerine işaret edebilecek şüpheli kalıplar gösteriyor. Dikkatli ilerleyin."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsTr.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictVerifiedSafeDesc to "Güvenlik tehdidi tespit edilmedi. QR kod doğrulanmış güvenli bir hedefe yönlendiriyor."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.AttackHomographExplain to "Tên miền sử dụng 'а' Cyrillic (U+0430) thay vì 'a' Latin (U+0061). Kỹ thuật này thường được sử dụng để lừa người dùng tin rằng họ đang truy cập một dịch vụ hợp pháp."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.CameraAccessDescription to "Kéo và thả hình ảnh mã QR vào đây hoặc bật quyền truy cập camera để bắt đầu quét."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.DangerousWarning to "URL này đã được đánh dấu là có khả năng nguy hiểm. Mở nó có thể khiến bạn gặp lừa đảo, phần mềm độc hại hoặc các mối đe dọa bảo mật khác. Bạn có chắc chắn muốn tiếp tục?"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.DomainUsesInternationalChars to "Tên miền này sử dụng các ký tự quốc tế có thể bắt chước các tên miền hợp pháp."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.FeatureExplainableDesc to "Đừng chỉ nhận \"Chặn\". Chúng tôi cung cấp phân tích heuristic chi tiết về các tham số URL, chuyển hướng và payload JavaScript."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.FeatureOfflineDesc to "Phân tích hoàn chỉnh được thực hiện cục bộ. Nguồn cấp camera và dữ liệu quét của bạn không bao giờ chạm đến máy chủ bên ngoài, đảm bảo quyền riêng tư tuyệt đối."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.FeaturePerformanceDesc to "Được tối ưu hóa cho môi trường desktop. Quét được xử lý sử dụng các tệp nhị phân Kotlin Multiplatform gốc."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.HeroDescription to "Mehr Guard phân tích các mối đe dọa tiềm ẩn trực tiếp trên phần cứng của bạn. Trải nghiệm bảo vệ với độ trễ bằng không."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.HeuristicAnalysisDesc to "URL được đánh dấu dựa trên nhiều yếu tố rủi ro được phát hiện bởi công cụ phân tích."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.LowSensitivityModeDesc to "Chỉ chặn các URL độc hại đã biết từ cơ sở dữ liệu mối đe dọa. Dương tính giả tối thiểu, nhưng có thể bỏ lỡ các cuộc tấn công mới."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.MetaOfflineGuaranteeDesc to "Hình ảnh này đã được phân tích cục bộ trên thiết bị của bạn. Không có dữ liệu nào được gửi đến đám mây cho phán quyết này."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.MixedScriptAttackDesc to "Tên miền chứa ký tự từ nhiều hệ chữ viết (ví dụ: Cyrillic + Latin). Phổ biến trong các cuộc tấn công homograph."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.OfflineGuaranteeDesc to "Phân tích Mehr Guard chạy hoàn toàn trên Neural Engine của thiết bị. Dữ liệu URL không bao giờ rời khỏi điện thoại của bạn."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.ParanoiaModeDesc to "Bảo vệ tối đa. Chặn mọi mẫu đáng ngờ bao gồm tên miền mới đăng ký, TLD không phổ biến và bất kỳ URL nào có thủ thuật mã hóa tiềm năng."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.PrivacyGuaranteeDesc to "Mehr Guard sử dụng các công cụ phân tích heuristic cục bộ. Không có dữ liệu hình ảnh, chuỗi URL hoặc siêu dữ liệu nào rời khỏi thiết bị này trong quá trình quét. Quyền riêng tư của bạn được đảm bảo về mặt toán học."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.ProceedWithCautionDesc to "Phát hiện một số chỉ số đáng ngờ. Xác minh nguồn trước khi nhập thông tin nhạy cảm."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.ReasonBrandInSubdomainDesc to "Tên thương hiệu xuất hiện trong subdomain nhưng không phải tên miền chính"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.ReasonCredentialParamDesc to "URL chứa các tham số liên quan đến thông tin đăng nhập (mật khẩu, token, v.v.)"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.RestrictedDesc to "URL này đã được đánh dấu là có khả năng nguy hiểm. Xem phân tích bên dưới trước khi tiếp tục."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.SafeToVisitDesc to "Được xác minh bởi heuristic cục bộ v2.4. Không tìm thấy mẫu lừa đảo, script bị che giấu hoặc khớp danh sách đen."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictDangerousDesc to "Mã QR được quét chứa các chỉ báo độc hại liên quan đến lừa đảo và thu thập thông tin xác thực. Không tiếp tục đến URL mục tiêu."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictMinorConcernsDesc to "Đã phát hiện một số lo ngại bảo mật nhỏ. Liên kết có vẻ an toàn phần lớn nhưng khuyến cáo nên xem xét."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictSuspiciousDesc to "Mã QR được quét cho thấy các mẫu đáng ngờ có thể chỉ ra rủi ro bảo mật tiềm ẩn. Hãy tiến hành thận trọng."
MaxLineLength:WebStringsVi.kt$WebStringKey.VerdictVerifiedSafeDesc to "Không phát hiện mối đe dọa bảo mật. Mã QR dẫn đến đích an toàn đã được xác minh."

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"All code execution happens in an ephemeral container that is destroyed after each scan. This ensures malicious payloads can never escape to your system." to "所有代码执行都发生在每次扫描后都会被销毁的临时容器中。这可确保恶意负载永远不会逃逸到您的系统。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Apple only uses apple.com for all account-related activities. Be wary of domains containing brand names but with different extensions." to "Apple 仅使用 apple.com 进行所有与帐户相关的活动。请警惕包含品牌名称但具有不同扩展名的域名。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Apple would never use a third-party domain for account verification. Check the actual domain name." to "Apple 绝不会使用第三方域名进行帐户验证。检查实际域名。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Atlassian is a legitimate software company. Their primary domain atlassian.com is trustworthy." to "Atlassian 是一家合法的软件公司。他们的主域 atlassian.com 值得信赖。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Challenge Mehr Guard's offline AI engine. Can you spot phishing URLs faster than the bot?" to "挑战 Mehr Guard 的离线 AI 引擎。你能比机器人更快识别钓鱼 URL 吗？"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Characters like Cyrillic \"а\" look identical to Latin \"a\" but are different" to "像西里尔字母“а”这样的字符看起来与拉丁语“a”相同，但有所不同"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Code execution happens in an ephemeral container. Malicious payloads never touch your OS kernel." to "代码执行发生在临时容器中。恶意负载永远不会触及您的操作系统内核。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Complete analysis is performed locally. Your camera feed and scanned data never touch an external server, ensuring absolute privacy." to "在本地执行完整分析。您的摄像头馈送和扫描数据永远不会接触外部服务器，从而确保绝对隐私。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Don't just get a \"Block\". We provide detailed heuristic breakdowns of URL parameters, redirects, and javascript payloads." to "不要只是得到“阻止”。我们提供 URL 参数、重定向和 JavaScript 有效负载的详细启发式细分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Exports include all identified threat vectors, headers, and the raw payload analysis." to "导出包括所有已识别的威胁向量、标头和原始有效负载分析。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"GitHub.com is a legitimate developer platform owned by Microsoft. Always verify the exact domain spelling." to "GitHub.com 是 Microsoft 拥有的合法开发者平台。始终验证域的准确拼写。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Google Docs uses docs.google.com. Always verify the sender knows you before opening shared documents." to "Google 文档使用 docs.google.com。在打开共享文档之前，请务必确认发件人认识您。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Google services use subdomains of google.com. mail.google.com is the legitimate Gmail address." to "Google 服务使用 google.com 的子域。 mail.google.com 是合法的 Gmail 地址。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"High-confidence phishing detected. This URL exhibits multiple malicious indicators." to "检测到高可信度网络钓鱼。此 URL 表现出多个恶意指标。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Homograph attacks use similar-looking characters. Always check URLs character by character for suspicious substitutions." to "同形异义词攻击使用外观相似的字符。始终逐个字符检查 URL 是否存在可疑替换。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If HTTPS was used, this signal would not trigger and score would drop by ~18 points." to "如果使用 HTTPS，则不会触发该信号，分数将下降约 18 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If a registered domain name was used instead of IP address, score would drop by ~28 points." to "如果使用注册域名代替 IP 地址，分数将下降约 28 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If all characters were ASCII Latin letters, this signal would not trigger and score would drop by ~45 points." to "如果所有字符都是 ASCII 拉丁字母，则该信号将不会触发，分数将下降约 45 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If no embedded URLs were present in query parameters, score would drop by ~18 points." to "如果查询参数中不存在嵌入的 URL，得分将下降约 18 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If only 1-2 subdomains were used, this signal would not trigger. Score would drop by ~12 points." to "如果只使用1-2个子域，则不会触发该信号。分数将下降约 12 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If the domain spelled the brand correctly without substitutions, score would drop by ~25 points." to "如果域名在没有替换的情况下正确拼写了品牌，得分将下降约 25 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If the domain used only ASCII characters (no IDN), score would drop by ~32 points." to "如果域仅使用 ASCII 字符（无 IDN），分数将下降约 32 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If the domain used readable words instead of random characters, score would drop by ~12 points." to "如果该域使用可读单词而不是随机字符，则分数将下降约 12 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If the full destination URL was visible, score would drop by ~18 points (assuming destination is safe)." to "如果完整的目标 URL 可见，得分将下降约 18 分（假设目标是安全的）。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If this URL used .com, .org, or country TLDs, score would drop by ~25 points." to "如果此 URL 使用 .com、.org 或国家/地区 TLD，得分将下降约 25 分。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"If this were the official brand domain (paypal.com), this signal would not trigger and score would drop by ~35 points." to "如果这是官方品牌域 (paypal.com)，则不会触发此信号，分数将下降约 35 分。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"LinkedIn uses linkedin.com as their primary domain. Profile URLs follow the /in/username format." to "LinkedIn 使用 linkedin.com 作为其主域。配置文件 URL 遵循 /in/用户名格式。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Look at the domain carefully. Is \"c0mmonwealth\" spelled correctly? The number 0 is often used to replace the letter O." to "仔细查看域。 “c0mmonwealth”拼写正确吗？数字0经常用来代替字母O。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Look closely at the domain structure. Legitimate organisations rarely use hyphens in the main domain name or generic TLDs like" to "仔细查看域结构。合法组织很少在主域名或通用 TLD 中使用连字符，例如"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Maximum protection. Blocks any suspicious patterns including newly registered domains, uncommon TLDs, and any URL with potential encoding tricks." to "最大程度的保护。阻止任何可疑模式，包括新注册的域、不常见的 TLD 以及任何具有潜在编码技巧的 URL。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Active Scanner - Real-time QR code scanning with AI-powered phishing detection." to "Mehr Guard 活动扫描器——使用 AI 的实时二维码扫描与钓鱼检测。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Dashboard - Enterprise offline QR code security with explainable threat detection." to "Mehr Guard 仪表板——企业级离线二维码安全，具备可解释的威胁检测。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Privacy Settings - 100% offline protection with zero cloud telemetry." to "Mehr Guard 隐私设置——100% 离线保护，无云端遥测。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Report Export - Generate and download threat analysis reports in PDF or JSON format." to "Mehr Guard 报告导出——生成并下载 PDF 或 JSON 格式的威胁分析报告。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Threat Analysis - Detailed scan result showing attack breakdown and security recommendations." to "Mehr Guard 威胁分析——显示攻击分解和安全建议的详细扫描结果。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Trust Centre - Manage privacy controls, detection sensitivity, and security lists." to "Mehr Guard 信任中心——管理隐私控制、检测灵敏度和安全列表。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard Web - AI-powered phishing detection running entirely in your browser. Scan and analyze URLs for security threats." to "Mehr Guard Web——在浏览器内完全运行的 AI 钓鱼检测。扫描并分析 URL 以发现安全威胁。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard processes every scan within a secure, isolated local sandbox. We prioritize explainable security with zero cloud telemetry for image analysis." to "Mehr Guard 在安全、隔离的本地沙箱中处理每次扫描。我们优先考虑通过零云遥测进行图像分析的可解释安全性。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard scan results - AI-powered phishing detection with detailed security analysis." to "Mehr Guard 扫描结果——带有详细安全分析的 AI 钓鱼检测。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard strictly disables all outgoing telemetry. Your scan results, URL history, and image hashes never leave your device." to "Mehr Guard 严格禁用所有传出遥测。您的扫描结果、URL 历史记录和图像哈希永远不会离开您的设备。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard uses local heuristic analysis engines. No image data, URL strings, or metadata leaves this device during scanning. Your privacy is mathematically guaranteed." to "Mehr Guard 使用本地启发式分析引擎。扫描期间不会有图像数据、URL 字符串或元数据离开此设备。您的隐私在数学上得到了保证。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Mehr Guard works 100% offline! All analysis is done locally on your device. No internet connection required." to "[[品牌]] 100% 离线工作！所有分析均在您的设备上本地完成。无需互联网连接。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Never trust shortened URLs from unknown sources. Use URL expander tools to see the real destination before clicking." to "永远不要相信来自未知来源的缩短 URL。单击之前，请使用 URL 扩展工具查看真正的目的地。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"No security threats were detected. The QR code leads to a verified safe destination." to "未检测到安全威胁。二维码指向经过验证的安全目的地。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Official postal services use their primary domain (auspost.com.au) for all tracking. Verify by visiting the official website directly." to "官方邮政服务使用其主域 (auspost.com.au) 进行所有跟踪。直接访问官网验证。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Only blocks known malicious URLs from the threat database. Minimal false positives, but may miss novel attacks." to "仅阻止威胁数据库中的已知恶意 URL。误报率极低，但可能会错过新的攻击。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Optimised for desktop environments. Scans are processed using native Kotlin Multiplatform binaries." to "针对桌面环境进行了优化。使用本机 Kotlin 多平台二进制文件可处理扫描。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Scans for known malicious patterns and heuristic mismatches. Blocks homoglyph attacks and redirect chains. Low false positive rate expected." to "扫描已知的恶意模式和启发式不匹配。阻止同形文字攻击并重定向链。预计误报率较低。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Short URLs hide the actual destination. Prize claims from unknown numbers are almost always scams." to "短 URL 隐藏了实际目的地。来自未知号码的奖品索赔几乎总是骗局。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Some minor security concerns were identified. The link appears mostly safe but review recommended." to "发现了一些小的安全问题。该链接看起来基本安全，但建议检查。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Some suspicious indicators detected. Verify the source before entering sensitive information." to "检测到一些可疑指标。输入敏感信息之前请验证来源。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The domain uses the Cyrillic 'а' (U+0430) instead of Latin 'a' (U+0061). This technique is commonly used to trick users into believing they are visiting a legitimate service." to "该域使用西里尔文“а”(U+0430)，而不是拉丁文“a”(U+0061)。此技术通常用于欺骗用户，让他们相信他们正在访问合法服务。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The domain uses the Cyrillic 'а' (U+0430) instead of Latin 'a' (U+0061)." to "该域使用西里尔文“а”(U+0430)，而不是拉丁文“a”(U+0061)。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The entire threat signature database (100,000+ patterns) is stored locally for millisecond lookups without any network requests." to "整个威胁特征数据库（超过 100,000 个模式）存储在本地，无需任何网络请求即可进行毫秒级查找。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The entire threat signature database is downloaded to your device for millisecond lookups." to "整个威胁特征数据库将下载到您的设备中进行毫秒级查找。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The number 1 and lowercase L look identical in many fonts. Always verify paypal.com directly." to "数字 1 和小写 L 在许多字体中看起来相同。始终直接验证 paypal.com。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The scanned QR code contains malicious indicators associated with phishing and credential harvesting. Do not proceed to the target URL." to "扫描的 QR 码包含与网络钓鱼和凭据收集相关的恶意指标。请勿继续访问目标 URL。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"The scanned QR code shows suspicious patterns that may indicate potential security risks. Proceed with caution." to "扫描的 QR 码显示可疑模式，可能表明存在潜在的安全风险。请谨慎行事。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Think you can outsmart our AI? Try to craft a phishing URL that fools the detector!" to "您认为您可以智胜我们的人工智能吗？尝试制作一个欺骗检测器的网络钓鱼 URL！"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"This URL was flagged by Mehr Guard\\'s offline phishing detection engine." to "此 URL 被 Mehr Guard\\ 的离线网络钓鱼检测引擎标记。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"This image was analysed locally on your device. No data was sent to the cloud for this verdict." to "此图像是在您的设备上本地分析的。对于此判决，没有数据发送到云端。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"This is a Google subdomain - check if it\\'s the legitimate Gmail service." to "这是 Google 子域 - 检查它是否是合法的 Gmail 服务。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"This may happen if: • You're using a very old browser • JavaScript is disabled • The page didn't fully load Try refreshing the page. If the issue persists, try Chrome, Firefox, or Safari." to "如果出现以下情况，可能会发生这种情况： • 您使用的是旧浏览器 • JavaScript 被禁用 • 页面未完全加载 尝试刷新页面。如果问题仍然存在，请尝试 Chrome、Firefox 或 Safari。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Tips for better scanning: • Ensure good lighting • Hold the camera steady • Fill the frame with the QR code • Avoid glare or reflections • Try uploading a clearer image" to "更好扫描的提示： • 确保良好的照明 • 稳定地握住相机 • 用二维码填充框架 • 避免眩光或反射 • 尝试上传更清晰的图像"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"URL path contains /login, /signin, /verify, /secure, /account" to "URL 路径包含 /login、/signin、/verify、/secure、/account"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Users may not notice subtle character swaps like \"1\" for \"l\" or \"0\" for \"o\"" to "用户可能不会注意到微妙的字符交换，例如“1”代表“l”或“0”代表“o”"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Verified by local heuristics v2.4. No phishing patterns, obfuscated scripts, or blacklist matches found." to "由本地启发式 v2.4 验证。未找到网络钓鱼模式、混淆脚本或黑名单匹配项。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"We strictly disable outgoing telemetry for scans. Scan results and image hashes remain local." to "我们严格禁用扫描的传出遥测。扫描结果和图像哈希保留在本地。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Without other risk signals, login paths on safe domains would not increase score significantly." to "如果没有其他风险信号，安全域上的登录路径不会显着增加分数。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Would you like to report this URL?\\n\\nOptions:\\n1. PhishTank - Click OK to open submission page\\n2. Email - Click Cancel to compose email\\n\\nURL: {url}" to "您想举报此 URL 吗？\\n\\n选项：\\n1. PhishTank - 单击“确定”打开提交页面\\n2.电子邮件 - 单击“取消”撰写电子邮件\\n\\nURL: {url}"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"You can still use Mehr Guard by uploading images or pasting URLs directly." to "您仍然可以通过上传图像或直接粘贴 URL 来使用 Mehr Guard。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"You can still use Mehr Guard: • Upload QR code images • Paste URLs directly • Use the sample URLs provided" to "您仍然可以使用 Mehr Guard： • 上传二维码图像 • 直接粘贴 URL • 使用提供的示例 URL"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Your browser doesn\\'t support camera access, or you\\'re on a device without a camera." to "您的浏览器不支持相机访问，或者您使用的设备没有相机。"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"Your data never leaves this device. All processing is local. No tracking, no uploads." to "您的数据永远不会离开此设备。所有处理都是本地的。没有跟踪，没有上传。"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"\"Always expand short links before scanning. The bot does this automatically by following redirect headers without rendering the page.\"" to "“扫描前务必展开短链接。机器人会通过跟随重定向标头自动执行此操作，而不渲染页面。”"

MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"\"AusPost: Your parcel failed delivery due to incorrect address details. Please update immediately via the link above to avoid return.\"" to "“AusPost：由于地址详细信息不正确，您的包裹投递失败。请立即通过上面的链接更新，以避免退货。”"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"\"Commonwealth Bank: Your account has been locked due to suspicious activity. Verify your identity immediately.\"" to "“联邦银行：您的帐户因可疑活动已被锁定。立即验证您的身份。”"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"\"Your Apple ID was used to sign in on a new device. If this was not you, verify immediately.\"" to "“您的 Apple ID 已被用于在新设备上登录。如果这不是您本人，请立即验证。”"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"characters often associated with phishing campaigns targeting financial institutions. The domain age is" to "通常与针对金融机构的网络钓鱼活动相关的角色。域名年龄为"
MaxLineLength:WebStringsZh.kt$"🔒 Zero data collection • 🚀 Same engine as Android & iOS • 🧠 Ensemble ML (25+ heuristics)" to "🔒 零数据收集 • 🚀 与 Android 和 iOS 相同的引擎 • 🧠 Ensemble ML（25+ 启发式）"
